podcast.title: Blues Focus and Iggy's Name
podcast.body: The Prime Movers was a blues band where James Newell Osterberg played as a drummer. It was during his time with this band that he became known as "Iggy," a nickname derived from his previous band, The Iguanas. "Next came the prime movers and they were more of a blues band and here's where Jim became known as Iggy because, well, he used to play in the iguanas."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Dread Zeppelin's Origin
podcast.body: Dread Zeppelin evolved out of a group called The Prime Movers. "Dread Zeppelin came together in Pasadena, California, evolving out of a group called The Prime Movers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Pasadena Origin (Evolved from The Prime Movers)
xref.body: The band originated in Pasadena, California, evolving out of a previous group known as The Prime Movers. "Dread Zeppelin came together in Pasadena, California, evolving out of a group called The Prime Movers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Post-Prime Movers Blues Focus
xref.body: After leaving The Prime Movers, Iggy initially focused on becoming a better blues player before reuniting with the Ashton brothers and Dave Alexander, which led to the formation of The Stooges. "He left the prime movers shortly after that to concentrate on being a better blues player."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Stooges?

xref.title: Tortelvis - Elvis Impersonator Frontman
xref.body: After The Prime Movers imploded, the remaining members reformed with an Elvis impersonator named Tortelvis, whose real name was Greg Tortelli. At the time he joined, he weighed nearly 300 pounds. "When that group imploded, they started up again, this time with an Elvis impersonator who went by the name Tort Elvis out front. His real name was Greg Tortelli, and at the time he joined the band, he was pushing 300 pounds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
